This weakness wasn’t really on display against the disastrous Titans offense, but I think we see Green Bay take advantage of this secondary in Week 2. The Jets also have a pretty legitimate front 7, which I think makes them a bit of a pass funnel.

I think Golden takes advantage of the man-heavy nature of this Jets defense (top 5 rate in 2025, 9th in Wk1), which the Packers themselves see a lot of (7th most in 2025). Since entering the league, Golden is 2nd among ALL WRs in separation score vs. man, and his YPRR has jumped from 1.66→1.84 against it per @FantasyPtsData. I like Golden to eat up this Jets secondary, in what I expect to be another big game for the Packers pass game.

The Bills also have a really weak linebacker group (31st projected unit per Mike Clay), and got torched over the middle of the field in Week 1. Amon-Ra was 4th among all WRs in MOF receiving YPG last year, and 7th in MOF target share.
